subject: Smart Notes exist to compound intelligence across time and Naya instances
title: The Superbrain must learn from every valuable lesson and carry the improvement forward
summary: Smart Notes are captured so valuable experience becomes durable, reusable intelligence. The Naya Note participates in the canonical intelligence lifecycle and, when applicable, propagates into PIS. Material updates should be discoverable through the Running Feed and daily intelligence layers, and every new Naya must restore the latest authoritative intelligence before acting.

learning.problem: If lessons are merely stored without propagation and successor consumption, the system repeatedly pays the cost of rediscovery and can repeat known mistakes.
learning.principle: Capture meaningful value so it can be learned from, propagated, inherited, and applied by future Nayas.
learning.loop: EXPERIENCE → CAPTURE → PERSIST → PROPAGATE → UPDATE → RESTORE → APPLY → VERIFY → IMPROVE → REPEAT
learning.purpose_of_notes: The purpose of Smart Notes is compounding intelligence, not note accumulation for its own sake.

intelligence_lifecycle.naya_note_to_pis: The Naya Note is the AI-facing learning representation and, when authorized/applicable, propagates through the canonical PIS lifecycle.
intelligence_lifecycle.pis: Primary Intelligence System / internal intelligence synthesis layer.
intelligence_lifecycle.cis: Collective Intelligence System/process that compounds validated learning across the broader Naya system.
intelligence_lifecycle.running_feed: Chronological operational orientation projection; it keeps Nayas aware of material changes but is not a competing memory authority.
intelligence_lifecycle.daily_intelligence: Reviews the day's captured intelligence and promotes material lessons, changes, wins, failures, and next actions into the appropriate durable layers.
intelligence_lifecycle.cold_start: Every new Naya should restore the latest authoritative intelligence before acting.

state_boundaries.persisted: The required representations exist in the authoritative repository.
state_boundaries.linked: Smart Links resolve to the actual persisted representations.
state_boundaries.propagated: The Naya Note has entered the PIS lifecycle.
state_boundaries.consumed: A later Naya has actually loaded the updated intelligence during restore.

evidence.runtime_claim_policy: Do not claim propagation or consumption merely because repository artifacts exist.

delivery.receipt: This canonical event plus the three representation artifacts are the repository evidence for capture/persistence.

next_action: Ensure the canonical runtime/acceptance path consumes the latest PIS and Running Feed state on restore, then prove propagation and successor consumption with runtime evidence.

provenance.source: Shawn's explicit explanation of why Smart Notes, PIS, CIS, Daily Intelligence, and the Running Feed must work together to compound intelligence across Naya instances.
